title: Jo Bhi Masroof
body:
Jo Bhi Masroof
(Ya Hussain) x4
(Jo bhi masroof-e-salaame, shohada rehta hai) x4
Wo to rehta nahi par naam, sadaa rehta hai
<<MINI>>
Jo bhi masroof salaame, shohada rehta hai, Wo to rehta nahi par naam, sadaa rehta hai
<<DIVIDER>>
(Shimr kehta tha yahi maa hai, Ali Akber ki) x3 Jiska ek haath kaleje pe, dharaa rehta tha hai

Jo bhi masroof salaame, shohada rehta hai, Wo to rehta nahi par naam, sadaa rehta hai

(Hai yeh sharmindagi paani ke, na ponchaane ki) x3 Naize pe bhi sar-e-Abbas, jukaa rehta tha hai
